topics.headline: US and Eurozone CPI both fell last month, not rose
topics.summary: Both June US CPI (3.5%) and Eurozone HICP flash (2.8%) dropped from prior readings, making "both higher" a fail on current data; renewed Iran-Strait oil spikes could lift July/August prints, but the base case per official releases is a miss.

topics.headline: HY spreads drift wider from historic tights amid AI selloff, heavy supply
topics.summary: At 2.69-2.74%, HY OAS remains near cycle lows but has ticked up as an AI-driven equity selloff and a heavy $7B new-issue calendar pushed spreads modestly wider, with weakness concentrated in CCC/single-B credits; a hawkish Fed dot plot and the July 28-29 FOMC meeting are the key near-term catalysts that could tip the tight-but-sticky range into a more decisive widening.

topics.headline: BTC ETF flows whipsaw: record outflow streak, brief reversal, then $425M outflow
topics.summary: After an 8-week, $8.2B outflow streak broke with a one-week $197M inflow, Bitcoin ETFs snapped back to $424.66M in outflows on July 13, even as BTC price rallied on soft CPI data—showing flows and price have decoupled and momentum remains fragile heading into the July 28-29 FOMC decision.

topics.headline: VIX near 16.5, but FOMC and Hormuz risk loom
topics.summary: VIX has cooled to ~16.5 from recent spikes, sitting below its 3-month average, but the July 28-29 FOMC meeting (with markets now pricing over 1-in-3 odds of a hike) and escalating US-Iran tanker attacks near Hormuz create real upside risk for a volatility jump within the 30-day window.

topics.headline: Chevron-Microsoft 2.67GW PPA confirms deal pace continues unabated
topics.summary: Beyond FERC's show-cause orders on grid interconnection rules, Chevron and Microsoft just signed a 20-year, 2.67GW off-grid power deal in Texas, reinforcing that hyperscalers keep securing dedicated generation capacity well within any 30-day window, even as regulatory and environmental friction (xAI's unpermitted turbines) escalates around behind-the-meter power.
